status: Conservative ordinary-handwriting additions for integration; not a definitive diplomatic edition.
coordinate_policy: Every rectangle is an exact pixel reading window in the full original image, top-left origin, x1,y1,x2,y2. Windows intentionally overlap to retain ascenders/descenders; they are not claimed as tight ink bounding boxes.
editorial_policy: Brackets mark uncertain readings or illegible omissions. Spacing and minimal punctuation supplied for readability. Abbreviations are not silently expanded. Capitalization, endings, and u/v distinctions remain provisional where the hand does not settle them.

identity_policy.note: Previously supplied Baudouin-Desportes and Pietro Aldobrandini identities are catalog/context metadata, not names independently read from this recto header.

method: Opening and difficult islands received a separate cautious visual reading; remaining words were retained only when source-supported. Subsequent exchanges checked specific letterforms without treating fluent context as evidence.
